name: article-writer
description: Turn a one-line subject into a publish-ready article via an 8-step, gated workflow with deterministic loop caps, a Step-5 plagiarism/attribution pass, and an adversarial fact-check review.

output_root.title: Runs root directory (optional)
output_root.description: Absolute path to a persistent directory where article-writer stores every run's input/interim/output folders, instead of the current working directory. Set this when Claude is launched from a temporary or sandboxed session directory (e.g. Cowork) that can disappear or become inaccessible — point it at a durable, synced location such as a OneDrive folder. Use forward slashes (e.g. C:/Users/you/OneDrive/ArticleWriterRuns) since the enforcement scripts run under bash. Leave blank to use the current working directory (original behavior). The directory is created if it does not already exist.

audience.title: Target reader / audience
audience.description: Default audience if the scope template leaves it unset. Reshapes scope, vocabulary, and depth.

angle.title: Angle / stance override
angle.description: Fix the angle instead of letting the agent derive it. 'auto' lets the agent choose.

length.title: Length / format target
length.description: Constrains scope and structure (e.g. short, medium, long, or a word count).

tone.title: Tone / voice
tone.description: Register and formality of the writing.

source_policy.title: Source policy
source_policy.description: Which evidence is admissible. 'default' uses the shipped whitelist/blacklist (requirements §6).

source_quality_threshold.title: Source-quality threshold
source_quality_threshold.description: Minimum tier a load-bearing claim may rest on.

per_gate_cap.title: Per-gate iteration cap
per_gate_cap.description: Max retries per QA gate (Steps 1-7) before escalating upstream.

adversarial_cap.title: Adversarial review cap (max)
adversarial_cap.description: Upper bound on the Step 8 adversarial review loop.

adversarial_min.title: Adversarial review floor (min)
adversarial_min.description: Minimum number of Step 8 reviews that always run.

escalation_routing.title: Escalation routing
escalation_routing.description: Where a capped/failed gate sends the work. 'default' uses the requirements §5.1 table.

plagiarism_ngram.title: Plagiarism overlap sensitivity (consecutive words)
plagiarism_ngram.description: The minimum run of consecutive words the Step 5 originality scan treats as a verbatim/near-verbatim match against captured source text. Lower = stricter (more flags). Detection sensitivity only; ethical remedy is chosen per passage.

citation_style.title: Citation / referencing style
citation_style.description: Referencing scheme for in-text citations and the bibliography. One of: apa, mla, chicago-author-date, chicago-notes, harvard, ieee, vancouver, none. If unset, Step 1 asks you explicitly.

output_format.title: Final article format
output_format.description: Format of the published article deliverable: 'docx' (Microsoft Word, default) or 'md' (Markdown).
